summary: Owner Authorization Service, step 1 (shared foundation for every AI teammate, module and channel). owner_authorizations (554-556, 566) gains coordinator (Amanda by default), executor and sensitivity_tier, fixed once requested, with a guard that a tier-3 action can never be authorized by reply. owner_execution_grants (567) gains kind (time_limited, as before, or standing with a written policy, at most one year) and policy; the window CHECK and the immutability guard are replaced to include them. New append-only authorization_events ledger recording the requesting teammate, coordinator, authorizing person and executing teammate separately, with the action, its fingerprint, the channel, evidence and result. No existing row's data changes; no journal, run or conversion row is touched.

preflight.name: authorization_events does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'authorization_events'

preflight.name: the 567 grant window constraint exists
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'owner_execution_grants_window'

preflight.name: owner_authorizations has no coordinator column yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'owner_authorizations' AND column_name = 'coordinator'

expected_changes: owner_authorizations gains coordinator (NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ai-team:amanda'), executor (nullable) and sensitivity_tier (NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 1 to 3), plus a BEFORE UPDATE guard: these three are fixed once requested, and a tier-3 request cannot become authorized by reply.

owner_execution_grants gains kind (NOT NULL DEFAULT 'time_limited') and policy (jsonb). The window CHECK now allows time_limited grants of at most 24 hours (unchanged) or standing grants of at most 366 days that carry a written policy. owner_execution_grants_guard is replaced to keep kind and policy immutable.
Creates authorization_events (append-only, RLS on, service_role SELECT and INSERT only) with five indexes.
Existing rows take the column defaults; no row data is updated and no journal, run, conversion or grant row is otherwise touched.

verify.name: every existing grant is time-limited
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM owner_execution_grants WHERE kind <> 'time_limited'

verify.name: every existing owner authorization is coordinated by Amanda at tier 1
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM owner_authorizations WHERE coordinator <> 'ai-team:amanda' OR sensitivity_tier <> 1

verify.name: the append-only and tier guards are present
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname IN ('trg_authorization_events_append_only', 'trg_owner_authorizations_service_guard')
